title: What to do if you experience a home water pipe burst
desc: Stop flooding damage and secure your insurance claim immediately.
todos: Shut off the main water supply valve to your home instantly to stop water flow.
Turn off electricity at the main circuit breaker if flooding is near electrical outlets or appliances.
Open faucets and flush toilets to drain remaining water from the plumbing pipes.
Document all structural damage and affected property with clear photos and video before starting cleanup.
Contact your home insurance company and call a professional emergency water restoration service.
